note: Heuristic flags for common delivery/junk items — not medical advice. Local-only.

trans_fat.label: industrial trans fats
trans_fat.why: Linked to heart disease risk when eaten often.

excess_sodium.label: very high sodium
excess_sodium.why: Frequent high-salt meals raise blood-pressure load.

added_sugar.label: high added sugar
added_sugar.why: Spikes glucose; easy to overshoot daily sugar budget.

acrylamides.label: acrylamide (fried/charred starch)
acrylamides.why: Forms in high-heat fries/chips; best as occasional treat.

nitrates.label: processed-meat nitrates/nitrites
nitrates.why: Processed meats often carry preservatives tied to long-term risk when habitual.

palm_oil_heavy.label: heavy refined palm oil / frying oil reuse
palm_oil_heavy.why: Common in cheap fried snacks; quality varies a lot by kitchen.

caffeine_sugar_stack.label: caffeine + sugar stack
caffeine_sugar_stack.why: Energy drinks / sweet coffee stacks can wreck sleep and crash energy.

ultra_processed.label: ultra-processed additives pack
ultra_processed.why: Many emulsifiers/colors/preservatives in packaged snacks — fine rarely, rough daily.
